description: Meta-workflow that chains discuss→plan→execute for all remaining phases. Top-level autonomous mode.

stages.name: init
stages.instructions:
Initialize the autonomous meta-workflow.

1. Call the gsd-guardian MCP tool 'state_load' to get the current milestone info.
   Extract: milestone_name, current_phase, project_root.
2. Call the gsd-guardian MCP tool 'phases_list' to discover all phases.
   Extract: the full list of phases with their numbers, names, and statuses.
3. Parse workflow args for flags:
   - --from N : start from phase N (inclusive)
   - --to N   : stop after phase N (inclusive)
   - --only N : execute only phase N (shorthand for --from N --to N)
   - --interactive : pause for user confirmation before each phase
4. Filter the phases list:
   a. Remove any phases with status 'Complete' or 'Archived'.
   b. If --from N is set, exclude phases with number < N.
   c. If --to N is set, exclude phases with number > N.
   d. If --only N is set, keep only phase N (error if it is already complete).
5. Sort the remaining phases by phase number ascending.
6. If no incomplete phases remain after filtering, report phases_remaining as 0 and stop.
7. Report phase count (total in milestone), phases_remaining (after filtering), and the ordered phases_list.
8. Set interactive_mode to true if --interactive flag was passed, false otherwise.

Report all required outputs.
stages.fail_message: Failed to load milestone state or discover phases. Ensure .planning/ is initialized and ROADMAP.md exists.

stages.name: execute_phase
stages.instructions:
Execute the full discuss→plan→execute chain for the current phase.

This stage is the core loop body. It runs once per phase and is repeated via the 'iterate' stage until all_phases_done is true.

1. Determine the current phase:
   - On first entry, use the first element of phases_list.
   - On subsequent entries (after iterate sets next_phase), use next_phase.

2. If interactive_mode is true, present the phase to the user and ask:
   'Execute phase ${current_phase}: ${phase_name}?' — 'Yes' / 'Skip' / 'Stop'
   If 'Skip', set discuss_done, plan_done, execute_done to false, verification_status to 'skipped', and proceed to iterate.
   If 'Stop', set all_phases_done to true and proceed to finalize.

3. DISCUSS step:
   a. Check if CONTEXT.md exists in the phase directory.
   b. If CONTEXT.md is missing, invoke the discuss-phase workflow:
      - Either call 'gsd_workflow' MCP tool with workflow='discuss-phase' and phase=${current_phase}
      - OR invoke the 'gsd-discuss-phase' skill via agent_skills + subagent spawn
   c. Set discuss_done to true when CONTEXT.md exists.

4. PLAN step:
   a. Check if PLAN-*.md files exist in the phase directory.
   b. If no plans exist, invoke the plan-phase workflow:
      - Either call 'gsd_workflow' MCP tool with workflow='plan-phase' and phase=${current_phase}
      - OR invoke the 'gsd-plan-phase' skill via agent_skills + subagent spawn
   c. Set plan_done to true when at least one PLAN-*.md exists.

5. EXECUTE step:
   a. Invoke the execute-phase workflow:
      - Either call 'gsd_workflow' MCP tool with workflow='execute-phase' and phase=${current_phase}
      - OR invoke the 'gsd-execute-phase' skill via agent_skills + subagent spawn
   b. Set execute_done to true when execution completes.

6. VERIFICATION step:
   a. Read VERIFICATION.md from the phase directory.
   b. Parse the status field: 'passed', 'gaps_found', or 'human_needed'.
   c. If 'passed': set verification_status to 'passed' — continue to iterate.
   d. If 'gaps_found': retry once — invoke plan-phase with --gaps flag, then execute-phase again.
      After retry, re-read VERIFICATION.md. Set verification_status to the new status.
   e. If 'human_needed': present the HUMAN-UAT.md items to the user.
      Set verification_status to 'human_needed' and pause for user input.

7. Report the current phase number, phase name, and status of each sub-step.

IMPORTANT: This stage nests OTHER workflows. The agent should call gsd_workflow recursively for each sub-step, or spawn subagents with the corresponding GSD skills. Do not attempt to inline the discuss/plan/execute logic — delegate to the existing workflows.

stages.name: iterate
stages.instructions:
Check iteration state and advance to the next phase or terminate the loop.

1. Remove the just-completed phase from the working phases_list.
2. Check termination conditions:
   a. If --only flag was originally set, set all_phases_done to true. Skip to finalize.
   b. If --to N was set and current_phase >= N, set all_phases_done to true. Skip to finalize.
   c. If phases_list is now empty (no more incomplete phases), set all_phases_done to true.
3. If none of the termination conditions are met:
   a. Set next_phase to the phase number of the next element in phases_list.
   b. Set all_phases_done to false — this will cause execute_phase to repeat.
4. Report all_phases_done and next_phase.

This stage controls the repeat_until loop. When all_phases_done is false, the WorkflowEngine will loop back to execute_phase (stage 1). When true, it advances to finalize (stage 3).

stages.name: finalize
stages.instructions:
Finalize the autonomous workflow run.

1. Compile a completion summary:
   - List every phase that was executed with its verification_status.
   - Count: total phases attempted, passed, gaps_found, human_needed, skipped.
   - Note total wall-clock time if available.

2. If --only flag was set:
   - Skip lifecycle suggestions.
   - Report the single phase result and suggest next steps.
   - Set lifecycle_complete to false.

3. If all phases in the milestone were completed (not just the filtered set):
   a. Suggest running 'audit-milestone' skill to audit milestone completion.
   b. Suggest running 'complete-milestone' workflow to archive and advance.
   c. Suggest running 'cleanup' skill to archive phase directories.
   d. Set lifecycle_complete to true.
   e. Set next_action to 'audit-milestone'.

4. If only some phases were completed:
   - Set lifecycle_complete to false.
   - Set next_action to the next incomplete phase number or 'manual-review'.

5. Present a completion banner:
   ╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
   ║   AUTONOMOUS RUN COMPLETE           ║
   ║   Milestone: ${milestone_name}      ║
   ║   Phases: ${completed}/${total}     ║
   ╚══════════════════════════════════════╝

6. Record the session using 'state_record_session' MCP tool.

Report all required outputs.
